provenance: Studio-profile thresholds, chosen 2026-08-19 against measured guard scores on a real recording processed by the studio core (StudioVoiceCore/DFN3): good restoration output measured mean_js 0.13-0.14, peak_js 0.63-0.68, envelope_correlation 0.99, consonant_retention 0.90-0.92, spectral_hole 0.02, musical_noise 0.07-0.08. Bounds are set roughly 2x the measured good-output values. The studio profile runs the guard in 'integrity' mode: spectral identity is NOT enforced (restoration changes the spectrum by design); timing, envelope, artifact, and collapse protections remain enforced.
